mainEntity.name: What is the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?

acceptedAnswer.text: encodeURI keeps characters such as : / ? & = # so a whole address still works. encodeURIComponent encodes them, so use it for a single value inside a URL.

mainEntity.name: When should a space be %20 and when +?

acceptedAnswer.text: %20 is correct everywhere in a URL. A + means a space only in HTML form data (application/x-www-form-urlencoded), such as query strings from forms.

mainEntity.name: Why does decoding fail with a malformed error?

acceptedAnswer.text: A % must be followed by two hexadecimal digits, and the bytes must form valid UTF-8. A stray % or truncated sequence causes this.
